# Anoop Sinkaran
**Senior Quality Assurance Test Engineer | QA Lead**  
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

---

### Professional Summary
ISTQB-certified Senior Quality Assurance Engineer with over 19 years of experience delivering robust testing strategies across financial payment processing, cloud platforms, and enterprise back-end architectures. Proven capability testing complex C#/.NET server components, web-based JavaScript/React interfaces, and executing SQL data validations for high-volume transactional systems. Demonstrated track record in leading production release cycles, spearheading defect triage and root-cause analysis, and driving software reliability within fast-paced Agile delivery squads.

- **Testing & QA Methodologies:** Manual Functional Testing, Backend & API Testing, Regression Testing, Test Planning & Design, Test Data Management, Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis, Cross-Functional Release Management, Usability Testing, Data Integrity Validation

- **Process & Frameworks:** Agile/Scrum, Sprint Release Cycles, Dual BA/QA Requirements Analysis
